_note: Press about Studio CAVA's own work: an outlet's editors choosing it, not a listing the studio posted itself (those are 'published' in projects.json). Newest first. Shown on the home (between press markers), on /studio/ and in the sheet of the project it is about. date is ISO; the card prints the month. outlets: the logo of each outlet, in site/assets/img/press (shown in black), for the press page and its cards. Logos identify the publication; the Archinect wordmark is traced from the share image Archinect sent with its feature.
